scope: Add wood and earth only; preserve the original six PNGs/manifests

jobs.name: 青芽
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production 2D anime game companion spritesheet for the Lingjing collection. Create ONE high-quality square RGBA transparent atlas, 4 columns x 4 rows, exactly 16 distinct full-body poses of ONE consistent original character. Match an elegant painterly chibi Japanese-anime companion style: fine colored linework, soft dimensional brush shading, large expressive warm eyes, delicate fur/material highlights, cute collectible-game polish. This must be organic character illustration, not geometric shapes, not a flat icon, not a 3D render, not pixel art.
Layout is critical: 16 invisible equal cells. Keep every character AND effect within the central 65% of its cell width and 70% height, leaving broad truly transparent gutters between cells and at the outside border. Character center at cell midpoint, feet at 82% cell height. Same scale, consistent costume, same facing slightly to viewer's right. Sleeping also rests on the same baseline. No limb, tail, antler, leaf, rock or spell may cross a cell boundary. Keep complete silhouette and intentional effects, never crop. No scenery, ground, drop shadows, solid background, checkerboard, text, labels, numbers, border, grid or watermark. Real transparent alpha, preserve fine antialiased edges.
Exact order left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
ROW 1: 0 relaxed standing idle eyes open; 1 the same idle with both eyes closed in a blink; 2 walking with left legs/paw forward; 3 opposite walking stride with right legs/paw forward.
ROW 2: 4 friendly single forepaw greeting raised outward; 5 a second cheerful greeting with forepaw tilted; 6 bringing a small appropriate snack to mouth; 7 chewing with a visible bite missing, puffed cheeks, changed face and paws.
ROW 3: 8 ordinary attack WINDUP with lowered body and forepaw/limb drawn BACK; 9 ordinary attack RELEASE with a forceful forward paw/limb strike and a small elemental arc; 10 unmistakable TAKING A HIT, backward recoil with scrunched eyes, ears back and a small impact spark, NOT a resting pose; 11 skill CHARGE with an elemental energy motif gathered near the chest/paws.
ROW 4: 12 skill RELEASE in a clearly different extended commanding pose with a larger but cell-contained elemental motif; 13 triumphant victory with raised forepaws and joyful face; 14 seated/low peaceful sleep eyes closed; 15 curled peaceful sleep eyes closed.
The attack, hit and skill frames MUST show truly different anatomical poses from greeting, idle and rest. Keep every pose the exact same character. Eating is a real food-handling pose in cells 6 and 7 only. Magic belongs only to the attack/skill/hit/victory cells, not scattered in other cells. No other characters or UI.
CHARACTER: QINGYA, an original WOOD-element FOREST FAWN. A small four-legged woodland deer with a graceful round body, light cinnamon-and-cream fur, white fawn spots, long leaf-shaped ears, tiny split hooves, a short fluffy tail and two small BRANCH ANTLERS carrying fresh jade-green buds. A sage/emerald leaf mantle around the shoulders, a little acorn-and-wood pendant and a few cream flower details identify it as a forest spirit. Warm green-gold eyes, gentle but energetic. It must look unmistakably like an antlered deer, not a dog, fox, cat or human, and not merely a green recolor. Keep the delicate branch antlers complete in every cell. Walking must alternate four deer legs, greeting lifts one foreleg, snack is a little green leaf/berry sprig. Ordinary attack draws a foreleg back then releases a short GREEN LEAF CRESCENT. Skill charge gathers a small green bud between forelegs; skill release extends the foreleg as an elegant curved VINE WITH LEAVES and blossom spiral unfurls. Vines/leaves stay entirely inside the cell. Hit recoils as a startled deer with folded ears; sleep folds the deer legs and curls the head toward its flank. Green living wood/nature effects, no flames, blue water, icy crystals or earth rocks. Original painterly anime companion art consistent with a polished navy/pastel chibi game collection.

CHARACTER: YANTUAN, an original EARTH-element BABY PANGOLIN. A lovable organic mammal with a rounded sand-tan body, a small tapered cream snout, tiny rounded ears, large amber eyes, short powerful legs with little natural digging claws and a long curled TAPERED PANGOLIN TAIL. Beautiful layered ochre/brown natural scales cover its back and tail, painted with softly textured terracotta/stone-like mineral highlights; NOT a blocky stone golem, not a toy made of polygons, not a dog recolor. A small amber geode pendant and two modest carved-earth wrist rings reinforce the earth identity without hiding the anatomy. Warm toasted beige, umber and muted gold palette, cream belly, expressive friendly face. Walking alternates short legs, greeting raises one clawed forepaw. Snack is a small golden root-shaped biscuit. Ordinary attack crouches and draws a forepaw back, then makes a forward DIGGING CLAW STRIKE with a contained arc of TAN SOIL AND SMALL PEBBLES. Skill charge gathers a warm amber stone glow between paws; skill release thrusts forward with a rounded STONE SHIELD / BOULDER ARC and golden dust curl, all fully within its cell. Hit rolls/recoils backward with paws scrunched and scales flexed, clearly different from idle or greeting. Victory lifts both paws. Sleep curls naturally around the scaled tail. Earth/rock/dust motifs must be visible and coherent; no green vines, fire flames, water or ice. High-quality painterly chibi anime illustration with natural detailed scales, not a geometric placeholder.
